gate-for-updating-a-holding-and-terminat.text: Gate for updating a holding and terminating its key on the proved design.

Issue 743. This page is for the commit owner, the auditor and the reviewers: each acceptance item, the hosted job and the verbatim command that proves it, and what each pull request must show. The requirements are in the specification and the pull requests in the plan.

rows.text: The ticket owner's table, written before the auditor's. The auditor writes its own table independently when it is seated; the ticket owner synthesizes the two once, records both input hashes and freezes the result in the runtime root before the commit owner starts. Every command is an existing hosted command, or one this ticket adds to a hosted job and marks "CI change in this ticket". Pull request 4's rows are written when its removal decisions are ruled.

Rows run scoped to what each slice can break. just ci runs once on the final candidate of each pull request, then the push; hosted checks on the pull request head are the net. Every build or test runs in a named, memory-capped scope: systemd-run --user --scope --unit=t743-<what>-<n> -p MemoryMax=24G timeout 3600 <command>.

evidence-the-pull-requests-will-carry.text: Evidence the pull requests will carry.
per statement: the validator test that executes it, the hosted step that runs it, and the RED run that showed it fail;
for each history statement: the generator, the inputs it covers, the counts and the seed;
the termination preimage byte vectors and the two encoders that reproduce them;

the journey job's receipt: the update, the booking with the treasury donation, the fold built by a second wallet from chain data only with the burn and the folder's payment, and the refused re-registration;
the refusals job's receipt: each of the four refusals and its control;
the conformance statement of the update and termination journeys, old against new;
left uncovered, stated in the pull requests: the reader (issue 744), batch limits (issue 746), release (issue 747).

synthesis.text: The ticket owner's table and the auditor's independent table were joined once on 25 October 2026. The auditor's table added the merged open-datum blueprint and confirmed every other row of pull request 1. RED evidence is lane evidence; the history statements are checked by property tests inside the Aiken suites, or by a check wired into a hosted job in the same change; the off-chain encoder runs in the off-chain suite. The link from a test to the Lean statement it executes is recorded in each slice's decision record.
